o.text: Inherited from Old Anatolian Turkish قرخ (qırḫ), قرق (qırq), from Proto-Turkic *kïrk (“forty”).
A derivation from Proto-Turkic *dïrŋa- (“to scratch, scrape”). Cognate with Bashkir тырма (tırma), see it for more cognates.
Borrowed from Arabic تَقْرِيبًا (taqrīban), adverbial accusative of تَقْرِيب (taqrīb). By surface analysis, təqrib + -ən.
